snippet.title: What time is it? - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the  playdate game "What time is it?".
NOTE:
You need a Playdate to play this game: https://play.date/

visit our website:
www.amigos500.dk

In What time is it?, you are shown a single image. Your task is to deduce the exact time shown and set the clock accordingly.
Each completed level rewards you with a hint. You can collect up to 3 hints at a time.
All levels are available from the start, and there’s no requirement to solve them in a specific order.
Become the master of logic by completing all 50 levels.
